user.title: Connect to your JBL Synthesis receiver
user.description: Enter the address of your SDR-35, SDR-38, SDP-55 or SDP-58. On the unit, General Setup → Control must be set to IP, and the receiver must be awake.

data_description.host: The receiver's hostname or IP address, shown on the unit under Network Settings.
data_description.port: The IP control port. The receiver always uses 50000, so change it only if you reach the unit through a port forward.

reconfigure.title: Change your receiver's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address. It must be the same receiver this entry was created for.

error.invalid_response: The device answered, but it does not speak the JBL Synthesis control protocol.

abort.wrong_device: That address is a different receiver. Add it as a new device instead of reconfiguring this one.

invalid_source.message: "{source}" is not one of the receiver's inputs.

invalid_sound_mode.message: "{sound_mode}" is not available for the current stream.
